{{Quote|This is the Ishori War Cruiser Predominance.|Captain Av'muru|<ref name="Specter" />}}
The '''Ishori war cruiser''', also known as the '''Ishori War Cruiser''', was a type of [[Cruiser/Legends|cruiser]]. One such cruiser, the ''[[Predominance]]'', [[Commanding officer/Legends|commanded]] by [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Av'muru]]<ref name="Specter" /> was used by the [[Ishori Confederene]]. In [[19 ABY/Legends|19 ABY]],<ref name="TERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates the events of ''[[Specter of the Past]]'' to [[19 ABY/Legends|19 ABY]].</ref> during the [[Caamas Document Crisis]], the ''Predominance'' was one of the 200 [[Warship/Legends|warships]] over the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Bothawui/Legends|Bothawui]]. The cruiser used its [[Engine/Legends|engines]] to approach several [[Sif'krie]] [[Skiff/Legends|skiffs]] and on its way, brought the [[YT-1300 light freighter/Legends|YT-1300 light freighter]] [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']] aboard with its [[Tractor beam/Legends|tractor beam]] while Av'muru spoke with [[High Councilor]] [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa Solo]], who was aboard the [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]], through [[Comm unit/Legends|comm]].<ref name="Specter" />

On the cruiser's [[Bridge (starship)|bridge]], [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] [[Chief of State]] [[Ponc Gavrisom]] ordered the captain to stop fighting [[Diamal]]a [[Starship/Legends|ships]] and approach a nearby [[Comet/Legends|comet]]. Once the ''Predominance'' reached the comet, the warships fought three [[Imperial I-class Star Destroyer|''Imperial I''-class Star Destroyers]]: the ''[[Tyrannic]]'', the ''[[Obliterator]]'', and the ''[[Ironhand]]''. The ''Tyrannic''{{'s}} commander, Captain [[Nalgol]], decided to withdraw and fled to the Imperial [[Capital/Legends|capital]] planet [[Bastion/Legends|Bastion]].<ref name="Specter" />
